morphology.pattern_note: 人名整词记忆，不按马来语词根或词缀拆分；规范正文写 Abigail。所列为常见英语读音，个人姓名应以本人读法为准。资料包未提供 Jawi。

senses.zh_definition: 阿比盖尔：源自希伯来语的女性名字，也可指《圣经》中同名的人物；实际所指由上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name of Hebrew origin, also borne by biblical figures.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Ibrani; rujukannya bergantung pada individu atau tokoh yang dimaksudkan dalam konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正文首字母大写。资料包没有 DBP 定义，此处为编写释义。所列搭配是自然的姓名使用框架，不代表已验证的高频固定搭配。英语读音、姓名来源及昵称参见 [Behind the Name：Abigail](https://www.behindthename.com/name/abigail)。

etymology.historical_story: Abigail comes from a Hebrew personal name commonly interpreted as 'my father is joy'. A biblical bearer was the wife of Nabal and later of David. English usage helped circulate the name internationally, alongside familiar forms such as Abby. These are naming traditions, not evidence of a Malay derivational family. [Behind the Name：Abigail](https://www.behindthename.com/name/abigail)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 常见英语读法可记作“AB-i-gayl”；把 Abigail 和昵称 Abby 配对记忆，但称呼本人时先确认她喜欢哪一种。
